guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：工業數位分身資料平台
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Industrial digital-twin data platforms
guides.concept: 以物理狀態、事件資料與分身一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect physical state, event data and twin consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「實體標識」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「時間版本」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：觀測時刻與入庫時刻需分開。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「流量預算」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：取樣頻率、記錄大小與數量決定原始資料率。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課資料率與一天容量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資料同化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：預測與量測融合需依誤差模型賦權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具高噪聲與低噪聲感測權重。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「許可權策略」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：讀狀態、寫設定與管理策略應分權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在玩具 API 圖分開三類角色許可權。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「分身驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：驗收需量測陳舊度、一致性與預測誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用合成亂序與缺測測試完整鏈。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for entity identifiers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for temporal versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation and ingestion times are distinct. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate late data and latest-state updates. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for traffic budgets. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rate, record size and device count set raw traffic. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate example traffic and daily capacity. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data assimilation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Prediction-observation fusion weights error models. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare high- and low-noise toy measurement weights. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for permission policies. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reading state, writing settings and managing policy are separated. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate three roles on a toy API diagram. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for twin acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance measures staleness, consistency and prediction errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test the chain with synthetic reordering and missingness. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「版本演化」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「增添欄位永遠不會影響舊消費者。」為何不成立。
提交「分身驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用合成亂序與缺測測試完整鏈。」如何辨別它們。
提交「分身驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「3D 外觀真實就代表模型與物理一致。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for version evolution; explain why this claim fails: Adding fields never affects old consumers.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for twin acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for twin acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Realistic 3D appearance proves physical consistency.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：3D 外觀真實就代表模型與物理一致。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Realistic 3D appearance proves physical consistency. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
guides.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with model monitoring and drift detection; use "Both compare predictions, observations and drift" to identify retained conditions.
For "Twins additionally connect entity states and permissions", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

history.textEn: Eclipse Ditto separates twin data and policies into services; this course studies semantics and consistency, not real industrial-device operation.
